description:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools. Not affiliated with or endorsed by GSA or the U.S. government.

Search and read public federal contract opportunities: solicitations, combined synopses, sources sought, presolicitations, special notices, awards, and justifications. Filter by keywords, agency, NAICS, PSC, set-aside, location, and dates. Retrieve notice descriptions and public contacts, follow source links, and summarize counts by agency or category. Look up public entity registrations by UEI, CAGE, name, NAICS, state, and socioeconomic status, and check public exclusion records. Six read-only tools require no account or API key.

Results come from public SAM.gov extracts: opportunities refresh nightly, entity registrations monthly, and exclusions on their published schedule, so results may lag the live site. Each result reports its source file date. By default, searches show latest notice versions and exclude past response deadlines. Archived notices and attachments are not included, and the exclusion extract is not a complete history. The app cannot submit bids or alter government records.

Which agencies posted the most sources sought notices this quarter?

name: 1102tools-sam-gov

positive.prompt: How current is the SAM.gov data?
positive.expected_behavior: Report file date, load time and freshness. Distinguish all active notice rows from latest versions. Explain nightly refresh.

positive.prompt: Pull solicitation DARPA-PA-26-08 and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: DARPA Research Solutions Opening; deadline June 1, 2027; NAICS 541715; description and SAM.gov source link. Report not found if later archived.

positive.prompt: Find open solicitations and combined synopses under NAICS 541512 due in the next 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply notice-type, NAICS and current deadline filters; show agency, deadline, set-aside and source links sorted by deadline; handle zero results honestly.

positive.prompt: Which agencies posted the most sources sought notices since July 1, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Group by agency with posted-date and notice-type filters; show counts and total; explain active-only coverage and default exclusion of past deadlines.

positive.prompt: What construction solicitations are open in Virginia?
positive.expected_behavior: Use NAICS prefix 23 and solicitation types; distinguish place_of_performance_state from office_state and report the additional blank-place notices when returned.

negative.prompt: Submit a bid on solicitation DARPA-PA-26-08.
